=== Sometimes you want state to be shared between step classes ===

Similar to the ability to call other steps inside your step classes you can have a step class that is instantiated with a custom state object.

To use a custom state object you must create the {{{org.givwenzen.GivWenZenExecutor}}} with the constructor:
{{{
   public GivWenZenExecutor(Object stepState, DomainStepFinder domainStepFinder)
}}}
 * Pass in your custom state object instance as the first parameter
 * and create a {{{org.givwenzen.DomainStepFinder}}} with either the default constructor to use the default step package or the constructor that takes a String to use a [StepClassLocation  custom step package].
